Asha (CSM): Quick follow-up from intro with Nora at Verdant Retail. They want a 4-week pilot: FAQ auto-responder + semantic product search. Looking for clear owners and measurable success criteria. Who can pick what? :wave:
Diego (Solutions Eng): I can lead the integration + infra checklist. Need sample catalog CSV and expected concurrency (peak qps). Planning a tech sync Tues 11am ET.
Nora (Customer PM): Thanks Asha. We'll provide product catalog + 3 weeks of live chat logs (anonymized) by tomorrow noon. Target traffic ~2k queries/day; peak qps ~6.
Priya (Account Exec): Heads-up: renewal conversation in ~10 months. Pilot outcome will heavily influence buying decision. We should aim to secure an exec demo after week 3.
Asha (CSM): Proposed owners: Diego (tech), Asha (enablement), Ethan (model + perf advice), Priya (exec liaison). Nora will coordinate their internal engineers. Any objections?
Ethan (Product): I'll recommend model variants and quant profiles. Given short prompts (~150 tokens) we can try int8 & 4-bit quant as A/B. I'll post a short cost/latency matrix by EOD.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Scheduling the tech sync now. I'll also publish a runbook and a small acceptance test suite. Example test command I'll use:```bash
./run_eval.sh --model redwood-lite --data verdant_eval.json --report reports/initial.json
```
onboarding-bot: Pilot playbook uploaded: <https://redwood.company/onboard/verdant/pilot-playbook> 1 items: checklist, calendar, escalation contacts.
Asha (CSM): Draft success metrics (please reply +1/-1): 1) p95 latency <= 300ms under expected peak, 2) FAQ precision >= 80% on their eval set, 3) product search MRR@5 >= 0.68, 4) cost <= $2.50 per 1k tokens. If we meet 3/4 -> move to exec demo.
Priya (Account Exec): +1. Also add an adoption signal: initial week retention (>=40% of daily users returning).
Nora (Customer PM): Sounds good. Can you add an item to measure hallucination rate on critical SKU responses? That's a showstopper for us.
Ethan (Product): Will add hallucination checks to the eval harness. Also propose a canary rollout plan: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 3 days if metrics hold.
Diego (Solutions Eng): I'll expose a simple trace link and token-cost breakdown in the runbook so Verdant can see unit economics.
Asha (CSM): I'll set weekly 20-min syncs Fridays 10am ET and put a shared notes doc. Nora, does Friday work?
Nora (Customer PM): Friday works. Thanks everyone 83. Looking forward to the tech sync on Tue.
Priya (Account Exec): I'll prep an invite for week 3 exec demo slot; Diego/Ethan/Asha please mark availability.
Asha (CSM): Action items summarized: 1) Diego: runbook + test suite + tech sync, 2) Ethan: model/cost matrix + hallucination checks, 3) Asha: enablement session + weekly notes, 4) Priya: exec demo coord, 5) Nora: data + stakeholder roster. I'll post progress updates here. :spiral_calendar:
